headline: Antonelli wins the United States Grand Prix
standfirst: Kimi Antonelli won the United States Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 13.078s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Max Verstappen completing the podium after 56 laps of Austin.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Kimi Antonelli lined up first on the grid. Antonelli converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Ocon, up 3 places to 12th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 2 times. Laps led: Antonelli (49) and Verstappen (7). Antonelli took the lead for good on lap 32. The race ran green from start to finish.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Antonelli made 1 stop, running medium → hard tyres. The field made 32 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.1s for Piastri on lap 15. 7 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Gabriel Bortoleto made up the most ground, climbing 8 places from 21st to 13th. Alonso went the other way, slipping from 12th to 16th. Timing recorded 220 on-track position changes, 17 of them by Albon.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Colapinto (lap 36), Bottas (lap 49) and Bearman (lap 25) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 35°C to 38°C, with air at 27–28°C. Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap, a 1:37.976 on lap 42.
